title: CBR-to-SQL: Rethinking Retrieval-based Text-to-SQL using Case-based Reasoning in the Healthcare Domain
authors: Hung Nguyen; Hans Moen; Pekka Marttinen
why_relevant: Proposes a CBR-style two-stage retrieval for medical text-to-SQL and evaluates robustness to retrieval perturbations and data scarcity, touching on noisy retrieval issues.
